title: The Beginning of a New Chess Game
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji's voice fell, at the far end of the starry river, a pair of cold eyes slowly opened—the ultimate chess player Cang Yutian had finally noticed this restless piece.

text.content: That gaze was like thorns on the back, as if thousands of fine needles were piercing into his soul simultaneously. Chen Ji stood on the shattered altar of the Celestial Realm, the chaotic qi surging endlessly around him, yet he remained motionless, only a cold gleam flickering in the depths of his eyes. 'Are you watching me?' he murmured softly, his voice torn to shreds by the howling gale. 'Then watch all you want.' Behind him, Ye Qing's figure emerged from the void, her face beneath the thin veil carrying a hint of gravity, her gaze never leaving Chen Ji, as if confirming something.

The air in the Celestial Realm was biting cold, each breath like swallowing shattered ice. Chen Ji slowly turned, his robes billowing in the wind, and a meaningful smile appeared on his seemingly ordinary face. 'Ye Qing, how long has this Heavenly Secrets Eye been watching me?' His tone was casual, as if asking about today's weather. The Demon Path Saintess slightly furrowed her brows and replied: 'From the moment I found you, it's been watching. A full three hours, without shifting once.' Upon hearing this, Chen Ji showed no fear, but instead laughed aloud: 'Three hours? It seems this little pawn finally has the qualifications to earn its direct attention.'

dialogue.content: 'Aren't you afraid?' Ye Qing's voice carried a trace of worry she herself hadn't noticed. Chen Ji turned to look at her, his gaze deep as an abyss: 'Fear? I have too many things to fear, fearing my plans will crumble to nothing, fearing my sister will never be found, fearing those who trust me will die because of me.' He paused, a mocking curve appearing at the corner of his mouth, 'But the one thing I don't fear is an old thing hiding in the shadows, watching. If it truly had the ability to destroy me directly, why would it go through so much trouble playing chess?' This caused Ye Qing to freeze in place, her gaze toward Chen Ji growing increasingly complex.

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, letting the gale of the Celestial Realm howl against his robes. In his mind, the Tianji Record Fragment glowed faintly, and that familiar Foresight Ability was gently flowing—not as a warning, but as active probing. At this moment, he made a reckless decision: instead of passively waiting, he would proactively reveal his cards. He wanted the Heavenly Secrets Eye to see clearly that the piece it thought it controlled had grown rebellious bones. 'Ye Qing,' he suddenly spoke, his voice carrying undeniable resolve, 'Help me spread a message. Tell the world—Chen Ji of the Tianqing Sect has established his domain in the Celestial Realm, openly recruiting all who are dissatisfied with the heavens.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's eyes widened abruptly, disbelief flickering in those deep eyes. 'You've gone mad?' Her voice rose several notches. 'Challenging the Heavenly Secrets Eye publicly in the Celestial Realm, do you know how many forces will target you as an easy mark?' Chen Ji turned to face her, his smile growing more playful: 'I know. But you should also know—nothing can be broken without being destroyed first.' His gaze fell upon Ye Qing with a hint of scrutiny. 'As for you, cooperating with a madman like me, aren't you afraid of dragging yourself down?' Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed softly: 'I'm already from the Demon Path, what else is there to fear? But you—Chen Ji, are you certain you can win?'

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer her question, only taking an ancient jade slip from his sleeve and casually tossing it to Ye Qing. 'This is all the intelligence I've gathered over three years—regarding the Heavenly Secrets Eye's arrangements, the secrets of the various sects, the coordinates of the Celestial Realm's forbidden grounds.' His voice was placid as water, as if discussing something trivial. 'If I fail, you release all of this to the public.' Ye Qing caught the jade slip, and when her fingertips touched its cold surface, her heart trembled inexplicably. She suddenly understood the terrifying nature of this man before her—he was never a gambler, but a chess player who had thought through all possible retreat routes.

After three years of planning, he had never once believed he would definitely win. But he had imagined countless possibilities of losing, transforming each one into continued bargaining chips. Ye Qing suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of appreciation she herself hadn't noticed: 'Chen Ji, you truly are a remarkable person.' She tucked the jade slip into her sleeve, her gaze sharpening. 'Since you want to act the madman, I'll accompany you in your madness to the end. Tell me, what do you want me to do?' Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing at the chaotic qi churning in the heavens, and slowly uttered four words: 'Conceal my aura.' Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: 'That simple?' Chen Ji nodded: 'That simple. I want the Heavenly Secrets Eye to be unable to see my next move clearly, and your Demon Path mist—is the only thing in this world that can shield the Tianji Record.'

Ye Qing said no more, forming seals with both hands as a layer of eerie black mist began to surge around her. That mist spread outward like a living thing, soon enveloping Chen Ji's entire form. Beneath the mist's concealment, Chen Ji's aura became ethereal and uncertain, as if he had merged with this realm, yet also as if he could dissipate into nothingness at any moment. 'Effective.' Ye Qing's voice came from beyond the mist, carrying some fatigue. 'But it can sustain at most one hour before the Heavenly Secrets Eye's窥探 will lock onto you again.' Chen Ji smiled within the mist: 'One hour is enough.' He closed his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfurling within his soul.

The Tianji Record's Foresight Ability activated once more, but this time not to peer into the future, but to organize existing intelligence. Chen Ji's spiritual sense was like a sharp blade, dissecting all his arrangements from three years: the rifts among the three great sects, the internal contradictions within the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, the embers of opposition in the Celestial Realm, the blind spots of the Heavenly Secrets Eye... All these fragments rearranged themselves in his mind, gradually outlining an unprecedented chessboard. 'I was wrong.' Chen Ji suddenly said quietly, a hint of self-mockery in his voice. 'I always thought I was a chess piece, doing everything possible to maneuver on the board. But now I understand—the distinction between piece and player was never determined by identity, but by vision.'

When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, a flash of brilliant light vanished from his gaze, replaced by an unprecedented certainty. 'Ye Qing, I need you to help me contact three people.' His voice was steady and powerful, each word carrying the weight of a thousand juncs. 'First, the Tianxuan Sect defector Zhou Chen, this person harbors intense hatred for the Heavenly Secrets Eye and is a core figure of the Celestial Realm opposition. Second, the reclusive elder of the Beiming Family, Ming He, who holds secrets of the Ancient Forbidden Land and has the blood feud of a murdered disciple with the Heavenly Secrets Eye. Third—' He paused, his gaze deepening. 'The heir of the Yaozu remnants, the nine-tailed celestial fox Bai Linglong. She has been trapped in the Celestial Realm for a long time, waiting for an opportunity to turn the tables.'

choice.prompt: The three factions each had strengths and weaknesses, and Chen Ji needed to make a strategic choice. This concerned not only the composition of the alliance but also determined how he would establish his footing in the Celestial Realm. How do you want to establish your chess game?

choices.description: Contact all three factions, establishing a loose alliance on equal terms. Steady and reliable, but may lack core cohesiveness.
choices.visible_reward: Gain support from three major forces, initially secure a foothold
choices.risk_hint: Internal calculations within the alliance may lead to betrayal later

text.content: Ye Qing heard this and slightly nodded: 'The way of balance, quite prudent.' Her fingers traced an arc in the air as three black tokens flew in different directions. 'Zhou Chen has an aloof temperament and needs sincerity to win him over; Ming He is crafty and deep, must offer sufficient leverage; as for Bai Linglong—' She paused, a meaningful smile appearing at the corner of her mouth. 'She hates being used most of all, you'll have to meet her personally.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji picked up the conversation: 'I'll meet Bai Linglong personally.' His gaze pierced through the Demon Path mist, looking toward the depths of the heavens. 'The nine-tailed celestial fox has been trapped in the Celestial Realm for thousands of years, waiting precisely for an opportunity. This opportunity—I give it to her.' Ye Qing watched him and suddenly asked a strange question: 'Aren't you afraid she'll make demands?' Chen Ji smiled, that smile carrying a playful air: 'Make demands? Wouldn't that be perfect? She has conditions means she has desires; having desires means she's willing to pay the price.' He turned, the Demon Path mist swirling around him. 'Let's go, let's meet this heir of the Yaozu remnants.'

choices.description: Concentrate resources to pursue Zhou Chen first, using the Tianxuan Sect defector as a breakthrough point to rapidly establish a core team. Fast speed, but concentrated risk.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming significant social resources, Combat Power -5
choices.visible_reward: Gain Zhou Chen's full support, obtain Tianxuan Sect core secrets
choices.risk_hint: Other factions may become estranged, missing alliance opportunities

text.content: "Ye Qing frowned: 'Zhou Chen? That's a tough nut to crack.' Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, a sharp glint flickering in his eyes: 'Only tough nuts are interesting. Soft bones will switch allegiance today—they'll betray you tomorrow. Zhou Chen is different; his hatred for the Eye of Heavenly Dao is ingrained in his bones. As long as I give him a hope, he will bite and never let go.' With that, he took a token from his sleeve. The token bore a blurred rune—the lost Sect Master's token of the Tianxuan Sect.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's eyes widened abruptly: 'This is—the Tianxuan Sect Master's Token? Where did you get this?' Chen Ji spun the token between his fingers, smiling meaningfully: 'Three years ago, from a dying man. Zhou Chen was expelled from the Tianxuan Sect because someone framed him for rebellion. This token was given to me by that person on his deathbed.' He put away the token, his gaze turning profound. 'What Zhou Chen wants isn't wealth or honor—he wants vindication. And this token is the vindication I offer him.' Ye Qing stared at him, suddenly feeling a chill creep up her spine. How many pieces had this man positioned in the shadows?

choices.description: "Skip the contact phase and directly declare war on the Eye of Heavenly Dao! Captivate the attention of all who are dissatisfied with the status quo with breathtaking boldness, a magnificent gamble."
choices.visible_cost: "Heavenly Fate -15, Hostility from All Forces in the Heavens +20"
choices.visible_reward: "Shake the Three Realms, Reputation Soars, Become the Iconic Figure of Resistance Against the Eye of Heavenly Dao"
choices.risk_hint: "May Provoke Direct Retaliation from the Eye of Heavenly Dao, Make Countless Enemies"

text.content: Ye Qing froze, her deep eyes filled with disbelief. "What did you say? A public declaration of war?" Her voice trembled. "Do you know what that means? The Eye of Heavenly Dao has been building its power for countless epochs, its influence deeply entrenched. As a mere废物 disciple, what makes you think you can—" Chen Ji raised a hand to cut her off, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his lips: "What makes me think? Because it fears me." He turned to gaze into the depths of the heavens, his eyes like blades. "If it wasn't afraid, why would it go to such lengths to set up schemes around me? If it wasn't afraid, why would it station a chess piece like Cang Yutian to watch me?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, and the aura around him shifted dramatically. On that ordinary face emerged a hegemonic dominance that overlooked the world. "Ye Qing, do you know what I despise most?" His voice was low and powerful. "Being used as a chess piece and manipulated. It wants me to follow its script—but I'll make it disappointed." He suddenly raised his hand, and a brilliant light shot into the sky, exploding into a massive rune in the high heavens—the original mark of the Tianji Record. "From this day forward, Chen Ji of the Tianqing Sect officially breaks with the Eye of Heavenly Dao!"

text.content: The moment the words fell, the entire heavenly realm seemed to fall silent for an instant. Then, invisible ripples spread from that exploding rune in all directions, like a boulder thrown into a lake, stirring up layers of waves. Far away, millions of miles distant, on the altar of the Tianxuan Sect, a jade slip that had been dormant for years suddenly glowed with faint light. In the depths of the forbidden grounds of the Beiming Family, a figure who had sat motionless for a thousand years slowly opened their eyes. Even among the ruins of the demon clan, a dormant white fox raised its head, gazing toward that dazzling light in the heavens.

Ye Qing stared blankly at all this, only recovering her voice after a long while: "You madman..." Chen Ji laughed instead, that smile carrying a child's gleeful triumph: "Mad? I think not." He turned, robes sweeping, as the demonic path mist swirled more urgently around him. "Wait and see. Within three days, those who have been oppressed by the Eye of Heavenly Dao for countless years will come to me on their own." Ye Qing frowned: "You're that confident?" Chen Ji turned back to meet her gaze, his eyes gleaming: "It's not confidence—it's insight. You think I'm gambling? No, I'm simply waiting for a moment—the moment when those being oppressed can no longer bear it."

Just then, a terrifying pressure suddenly descended from the depths of the heavens. That pressure was like an invisible giant hand, slowly pressing down from the Nine Heavens, carrying the nuance of scrutiny and warning. Ye Qing's face instantly turned pale: "It's here..." Chen Ji, however, remained unmoved, even his smile deepening. "Good timing." He murmured, his voice carrying a near-provocative audacity. "I was afraid it wouldn't come." He raised his right hand, and the Tianji Record Fragment materialized in his palm, ancient runes emanating a ghostly glow, facing off against the pressure from the Nine Heavens.

dialogue.content: A cold voice suddenly rang in Chen Ji's mind—not from any direction, yet seemingly coming from everywhere: "Chen Ji, you have crossed the line." Upon hearing this, Chen Ji showed no fear, instead laughing aloud: "Crossed the line? Tell me, Heavenly Dao, which line did I cross?" The voice fell silent for a moment, and when it spoke again, there was a barely perceptible fluctuation: "You are challenging the authority of Heaven." Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, gazing up at the vast sky, his voice ringing out: "I dare not. I only wish to tell the Heavenly Dao one thing—from today forward, I am no longer a chess piece." His voice echoed through the heavens, carrying unyielding resolve. "I am the chess player."

text.content: The voice of the Eye of Heavenly Dao spoke again, this time tinged with a murderous intent: "Chess player? Do you think a broken Tianji Record allows you to play against Heaven?" Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile carrying a composure of someone who had seen through everything: "Heavenly Dao, you misunderstand. The Tianji Record is merely a tool. A chess player's true capital—" He spread his arms wide, as if embracing the entire heavens. "—is those people who have been oppressed by you for countless years, yet never surrendered." He cast his gaze upward. "Look—Zhou Chen is here, Ming He is here, and Bai Linglong is here as well."

As Chen Ji's voice faded, three figures descended from different directions of the heavens. The first was a gaunt middle-aged man, emanating a chilling sword intent—the Tianxuan Sect's exiled cultivator Zhou Chen. The second was an elderly man with white hair and youthful face, surrounded by幽蓝色的冥火—the hidden elder of the Beiming Family, Ming He. The third was a breathtakingly beautiful woman, with nine white tails faintly visible behind her—the young mistress of the demon clan's remnant lineage, Bai Linglong. All three gazed at Chen Ji simultaneously, their expressions varied yet all carrying scrutiny and probing.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji surveyed the three, a faint smile curling at his lips: "Gentlemen and lady, Chen Ji is honored by your presence." Zhou Chen snorted coldly, his sword intent sharp: "Enough pleasantries. Since you dare to publicly break with the Eye of Heavenly Dao, you must have a foolproof plan. Speak—what do you want us to do?" Chen Ji shook his head: "It's not about what I want you to do; it's about what you want to do." His gaze swept across the three, becoming profound and earnest. "I am merely the one providing an opportunity. As for whether you seize that opportunity—that is your choice."

text.content: Ming He stroked his beard, his murky old eyes flashing with insight: "Quite the grand口气. As a mere废物 disciple, what gives you the right to offer us opportunities?" Upon hearing this, Chen Ji showed no anger—instead, he laughed even more cheerfully: "Because I know things you don't know, because I can see futures you cannot see." He raised his right hand, and the Tianji Record Fragment slowly materialized in his palm, emanating an ancient and mysterious aura. "Do the three of you recognize this?" Zhou Chen and Ming He's expressions changed simultaneously, and even the usually composed Bai Linglong revealed a shock.

"The Tianji Record..." Bai Linglong murmured to herself, her voice trembling slightly. "The legendary treasure that can peer into Heavenly Secrets and foretell the future? Wasn't it lost long ago?" Chen Ji withdrew the fragment into his sleeve, speaking calmly: "Lost? No—it has simply chosen a new master." His gaze turned sharp. "Let me be clear today—I haven't come to ask for your help. I've come to make a deal with you. You help me oppose the Eye of Heavenly Dao, and I'll help you achieve your desires. Zhou Chen wants vindication, Ming He wants the secrets of the forbidden grounds, Bai Linglong wants to revive the demon clan—all of which the Tianji Record can help you accomplish."

choice.prompt: The three powerful figures have appeared, and Chen Ji needs to decide how to establish a cooperative relationship with them. This will determine the core faction against the Eye of Heavenly Dao in the future.

choices.description: "Form an alliance with the three as equals, with the four parties making decisions together and power distributed. Stable but low decision-making efficiency."
choices.visible_reward: The Three Factions Truly Submit, Alliance is Solid
choices.risk_hint: Difficult to Unify Actions When Opinions Diverge

text.content: Chen Ji surveyed the three, his expression serious: "I propose a four-way alliance, moving forward together. Major decisions will be discussed by all four, and when opinions differ, the minority obeys the majority." Zhou Chen frowned: "A four-way alliance? Then who has the final say?" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Whoever is right has the final say. Esteemed ones, you are all sages of our era—surely you won't object to being persuaded by reason?" Ming He stroked his beard and laughed: "The young friend is candid. Very well, this old one agrees." Bai Linglong pondered briefly, then nodded as well. And so, an alliance that seemed loose yet held boundless potential quietly took shape amidst the ruins of the heavens.

dialogue.content: "The alliance is just formed when Ye Qing quietly approaches Chen Ji, lowering his voice: 'Aren't you afraid they'll comply outwardly but oppose inwardly?' A knowing smile curves Chen Ji's lips: 'Comply outwardly and oppose inwardly? Of course they will. But as long as they need the Tianji Record, they need me.' He pauses, a calculating gleam flickering in his eyes, 'Moreover, the alliance is merely the surface. What I truly intend is to make them fight amongst themselves while being forced to depend on me. This is the highest realm of a chess player—making the pieces believe they are the chess players.'"

choices.description: "Using the Tianji Record as the bond, with Chen Ji dominating decisions and the other three parties providing support. High efficiency but may arouse dissatisfaction."
choices.visible_cost: "Three parties are in awe but secretly harbor resentment, Trust -10"
choices.risk_hint: "May encounter internal betrayal in later stages"

text.content: "Chen Ji stands with hands behind his back, his entire aura suddenly shifting, that ordinary face displaying an unquestionable majesty. 'Everyone, the Tianji Record is in my hands, and I know the weaknesses of the Heavenly Eye better than any of you.' His voice isn't loud, yet it clearly reaches everyone's ears, 'Therefore, this alliance—I have the final say.' Zhou Chen's sword-like brows rise sharply, killing intent flourishing: 'You, a mere—' Before he finishes, Chen Ji raises his hand, projecting a foresight vision directly into the void—it is the complete process of Zhou Chen being framed years ago."

dialogue.content: "Zhou Chen's expression instantly turns ashen, those sword-like eyes flickering with complex emotions—shock, fury, humiliation, and a trace of gratitude that's hard to detect. Chen Ji retracts the vision, calmly saying: 'The person who framed you back then, I've been investigating for three years. Now, do you want revenge, or do you want rehabilitation?' Zhou Chen remains silent for a long while before finally kneeling on one knee, clasping his fist: 'Zhou Chen... is willing to take orders.' Ming He and Bai Linglong exchange a glance, then both lower their heads. Thus, with absolute strength and leverage, Chen Ji establishes the first power in the heavenly realm entirely dominated by him."

choices.description: "Establish different levels of cooperation with the three parties respectively, adjusting the front lines anytime as needed. Flexible and mobile but lacking deep trust."
choices.visible_cost: "Requires continuous maintenance of relations with all parties, Charm -10"
choices.visible_reward: "Free to advance or retreat, can adjust strategy at any time according to the situation"
choices.risk_hint: "Once someone sees through your tricks, the alliance may collapse instantly"

text.content: "Chen Ji's gaze sweeps across the three people, then suddenly smiles: 'Everyone, I have a proposal.' His voice becomes meaningful, 'Alliances are too rigid. Why don't we try a flexible form of cooperation. Brother Zhou Chen, I'll help you with your revenge, but when the time comes to act, you must charge at the front. Senior Ming He, I'll give you the forbidden land secrets in batches, and you help me hold the line for a while. As for Miss Bai Linglong—' He looks at the nine-tailed fox demon, his smile growing more brilliant, 'Help me contact the old demon clan forces, and I'll help you reopen the Demon Imperial Palace. How about that?'"

dialogue.content: "Upon hearing this, the three people's expressions shift各不相同. Zhou Chen coldly snorts: 'Quite the fine calculations you've made.' Ming He strokes his beard with a smile: 'Interesting, each taking what they need, neither subordinate to the other. Young friend truly is a cunning one.' Bai Linglong ponders for a moment, saying: 'The key to the Demon Imperial Palace, I do want it. But this form of cooperation... I need to consider it further.' Chen Ji nods: 'Take your time considering, but I advise the three of you to decide quickly.' He looks up toward the horizon, where the pressure of the Heavenly Eye still surges slowly, 'Because our time is running out.'"

text.content: "Just as various forces secretly struggle, a sudden disturbance comes from the depths of the heavens. The oppressive force that had been shrouding the heavenly realm suddenly lifts, as if something has收敛了气息. Ye Qing's expression changes: 'Did it retreat?' Chen Ji shakes his head, a trace of solemnity flickering in his eyes: 'Not a retreat, it's gathering greater forces.' He turns to look at the three people, his voice becoming serious: 'Everyone, the real test is coming.' Zhou Chen draws his sword and stands, sword intent soaring to the skies: 'Come then, I've been waiting for this day for a very long time.' Ming He and Bai Linglong also nod, a great battle seemingly inevitable."

"However, defying everyone's expectations, no heavenly punishment descends, nor does the anticipated army press at the borders. Instead, a gentle yet irresistible voice sounds, directly resonating in the minds of everyone present: 'Interesting.' That voice is ordinary yet carries an undeniable pressure, 'Chen Ji, you're smarter than I imagined.' Chen Ji squints his eyes—he knows the master of this voice is the true opponent—the ultimate chess player, Cang Yutian."

"Cang Yutian's voice continues, unhurried, as if narrating a trivial matter: 'You think gathering a few ants dissatisfied with heaven can change anything?' Chen Ji stands with hands behind his back, a mocking arc curling at his lips, yet says nothing. Cang Yutian seems not to expect his answer, simply saying calmly: 'Very well, since you want to play, I'll play this game to the end.' As the words fall, from the distant depths of the heavens, a pair of cold eyes slowly opens, watching all of this. The master of those eyes is precisely Cang Yutian—the ultimate chess player, finally making his formal entrance."
